digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md documentation / transition close workflow
propositions: AGENTS.md incorrectly claims the close precheck requires the MERGED rebar-ticket commit reachable from HEAD, when in fact _referencing_commit_exists scans all history reachable from HEAD and accepts any commit (merged or not) with the ticket reference or descendant reference.
The close precheck is conditional on recorded file_impact and completion-verification gate state, not unconditional; the documentation presents it as always enforced.

The rebar transition --ref option for closing stacked stories against their own commit without moving the worktree is undocumented in AGENTS.md despite being documented in transition.txt and plan-review-gate.md.
The land-before-close ordering rule is actually enforced by the Verified +1 policy, not by the precheck mechanism as the documentation implies.
CONTRIBUTING.md §2f repeats the same false merged-commit claim and must be corrected alongside AGENTS.md to keep the long-form authoritative copy accurate.
